name: Positioning Custom View -- Benchmark Basis + Juxtaposed Model-Actual Bars
description: Expansion of POSN_CUSTOM (complete 2026-07-10, portal-v2.1.135). Two parts, both FE-only in portal/src/pages/Positioning/. PART 1 -- BENCHMARK BASIS: the Custom view currently computes the blend + matrix over the models' PORTFOLIO (actual) data (PositioningSummary.tsx dataMode falls back to 'portfolio' when Custom is engaged); flip it to 'benchmark' so the custom blend, allocation bars, and the full expanded-characteristics matrix (yield/cost/duration/beta + sub-categories) all derive from the models' BENCHMARK values -- stable per-model anchors, so the client-mix math is not chased by market drift (Yang, call 2026-07-10 02:35-04:32: 'the calculator should be based upon the benchmark... intermediate term is always 60%, short term is always 15%... using benchmark kind of eliminates that concern'; Andrew 2026-07-14: 'using the benchmark toggle data as opposed to the model toggle data'). PART 2 -- JUXTAPOSED BARS: in the Custom view ONLY, every stacked allocation bar becomes a PAIR -- the opaque bar carries the benchmark basis, and a slightly transparent companion bar carries the model's ACTUAL portfolio allocation, so the intentional tilt (Yang's '69 vs 60') stays visible; ALL SIX columns pair (the 5 models AND the Custom blend bar, whose companion is the same weights over model-actual data). Both scope decisions Andrew-selected in-session 2026-07-14 (AskUserQuestion: 'Custom view only' + 'Yes, pair it too'). Mode B (target-equity) explicitly NOT in scope (Andrew 2026-07-14: 'we dont need the mode b, its just the visualization piece'). Portfolio/Benchmark/Relative views unchanged; HoldingsTab CSM unchanged (holdings blend stays over actual model holdings -- benchmarks carry no holdings).
